acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — offline capture is a first-class mode, not a fallback. Entries are held in a durable on-device queue and sync in order the moment the connection returns, so nothing is lost in a Wi-Fi dead zone. The offline document viewer, for a WPS or a plan, is on every plan.

It makes cost predictable: one published flat rate per appliance with workers included, extra seats at €9/month, hardware passed through at cost, and every add-on in plain euros — so total cost of ownership can be modelled up front.

mainEntity.name: What happens to our data if we cancel?

acceptedAnswer.text: It stays with you. The data is on your physical hardware, and you keep view-only access to all historical records for audits. There is no lock-in and no exit fee.

mainEntity.name: Can staff still access it remotely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, securely. Authorised staff — and even auditors — connect through Phrakton, our secure network overlay, while the appliance stays off the public internet — remote reach without exposing your factory.

Not the way we run it: your only job is to keep the appliance powered on, and we handle the rest, as described under No Cloud to Depend On. For how the managed model works in general, read managed on-premise, explained.
